statement: The six-byte physical Classic Controller Pro identification value and model/third-party variants are not proven by the currently pinned Dolphin, Linux and SDL source records: Dolphin models the Classic identity, Linux classifies Classic by the final two bytes, and SDL requests only those two bytes. An oldid-pinned, raw-wikitext-hashed WiiBrew Extension Controllers source and/or reference hardware A400FA register capture would resolve the reported full ID, including any leading-byte discriminator.

applicability.revision: Classic Controller Pro; no physical sample
applicability.scope: Retail device-side extension identity unknown from current pinned sources; current publicly rendered WiiBrew page suggests a full value but may not be promoted until its exact oldid raw wikitext is hashed. No implementation-specific claim of physical Classic Pro identity.
